items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Alvin Alcorn on trumpet... And we stayed with that band about three or four years with Sidney's... Then I went and got Kimball, Louis Barbaran, Alvin Alcorn, and myself with the full tunes.

ctx.x: We used to play two bands at the Gypsy. Yeah, at the Gypsy band. Yeah. I had a mixed band. Yeah. Yeah, I was in the neighborhood. We used to have two bands on Sunday evening. Do you remember the members of Sidney's band on the Fairroom?

Let's see now. Joe Phillips was on trumpet. Alvin Alcorn on trumpet. And Sidney's on trumpet. Eddie Pearson was on trombone. And I forgot the fellow's other name from Cross the River. He was on trombone, too. He wrote. To trombone. No, not the Rooks. Brownskin boy, collecting insurance.
Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. We met him one time. I can't think of his name. And I told you he was a very fine trombone player.
